raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Motivation

Under `--enable-torch-compile` with `--tp-size > 1`, every row-parallel layer breaks the DiT graph at its all-reduce. `GroupCoordinator.all_reduce` calls the custom all-reduce inline, and Dynamo cannot trace its tvm_ffi communicator:

```
Graph break in user code at sglang/kernels/ops/communication/all_reduce.py:169
  Explanation: Dynamo does not know how to trace method `get_world_size` of class `Communicator`
  Explanation: torch.compile detected a graph break in a for/while loop. Skipping the frame and falling back to eager
```

The break is inside the block loop, so Dynamo gives up on the whole frame and compiles each block separately, with a break at every all-reduce. srt avoids this by routing its all-reduce through an opaque custom op (`outplace_all_reduce`). Diffusion has its own `GroupCoordinator` and never did.

## Modifications

- `diffusion_all_reduce`: an out-of-place custom op (`register_custom_op(out_shape="tensor")`). Like srt's ops, it takes the group by name, from a weak-reference registry filled in `GroupCoordinator.__init__`.
- Under `torch.compiler.is_compiling()`, a SUM all-reduce on a group that has the custom all-reduce goes through the op. The op runs `_all_reduce_out_of_place`: the custom all-reduce when the tensor qualifies, otherwise NCCL on a copy, because a custom op may not mutate or return its input.
- Eager is unchanged. Groups without the custom all-reduce keep tracing `torch.distributed.all_reduce` natively.

## Accuracy Tests

The math is identical (the same custom all-reduce or NCCL sum). Moving the all-reduce into an opaque op changes how inductor fuses the code around it. Qwen-Image-2.1, TP2, compile, seed 42, against the same tree without this PR: MAE 0.415/255, PSNR 46.4 dB. That is floating-point reordering.

## Speed Tests and Profiling

4xGB300, served, 1024x1024. Baseline: main 3831e7e09 plus the open GB300 fixes (#43565 NUMA binding, #43568, #43577, #43575, #43576, #43584, #43586). Each cell is the median of 5 requests after warmup. Rounds are interleaved (ABAB), and every arm runs on a fresh server.

| case (TP2) | compile, baseline | compile, this PR | change |
|---|---:|---:|---:|
| FLUX.1-dev, round 1 / 2 | 3.651 / 3.702 s | **2.647 / 2.588 s** | −28% / −30% |
| Qwen-Image-2.1, `--offload-during-compile false`, round 1 / 2 | 2.199 / 2.138 s | **1.501 / 1.496 s** | −32% / −30% |
| Qwen-Image-2.1, default (offload during compile on), round 1 / 2 | 2.219 / 2.280 s | 2.179 / 2.181 s | −2% / −4% |

For reference, eager is FLUX.1 ~4.0 s and Qwen-Image-2.1 1.70–1.73 s. With this PR, compile beats eager on both.

Qwen-Image-2.1 gains little with offload-during-compile on (the default), for an unrelated reason. Its warmup traces the layerwise-offload hooks, and the `torch.compiler.disable` calls inside them graph-break inside the block loop. Dynamo then skips the transformer frame for good (`ConvertFrameReturn` defaults to SKIP with `apply_to_code=True`), so serving keeps per-block graphs even after the hooks are removed. That is a separate fix.

## Checklist

- [x] Format your code according to the [Format code with pre-commit](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#format-code-with-pre-commit).
- [x] Add unit tests: `test_group_coordinator_compiled_all_reduce.py`:
  - A `fullgraph=True` compile of `all_reduce`. Without this PR it raises `Unsupported: Skip calling torch.compiler.disable()'d function`.
  - The op schema mutates nothing.
  - The op reaches its group by name (CUDA).
  - The out-of-place helper uses the custom all-reduce, or reduces a copy and leaves the input untouched.

  On GB300, together with `test_diffusion_bcg_tp_graph_capture.py` and `test_single_rank_device_group.py`: 17 passed.
- [ ] Update documentation: N/A.
- [x] Provide accuracy and speed benchmark results.
- [x] Follow the SGLang code style guidance.

+"""A compiled TP all-reduce must not graph-break on the custom all-reduce."""
+
+import unittest
+import weakref
+from types import SimpleNamespace
+from unittest.mock import patch
+
+import torch
+
+from sglang.multimodal_gen.runtime.distributed import group_coordinator
+from sglang.multimodal_gen.runtime.distributed.group_coordinator import (
+    GroupCoordinator,
+)
+from sglang.test.test_utils import CustomTestCase
+
+
+class _Group(SimpleNamespace):
+    """Weak-referenceable, as the op registry holds groups by weak reference."""
+
+    def _all_reduce_out_of_place(self, tensor):
+        return GroupCoordinator._all_reduce_out_of_place(self, tensor)
+
+
+def _group(name: str, *, accepts: bool) -> _Group:
+    custom_ar = SimpleNamespace(
+        disabled=False,
+        should_custom_ar=lambda tensor: accepts,
+        # Stands in for the tvm_ffi communicator call Dynamo cannot trace.
+        custom_all_reduce=torch._dynamo.disable(lambda tensor: tensor * 2),
+    )
+    group = _Group(
+        world_size=2,
+        unique_name=name,
+        srt_custom_allreduce=custom_ar,
+        device_group=None,
+    )
+    group_coordinator._groups[name] = weakref.ref(group)
+    return group
+
+
+class TestCompiledAllReduce(CustomTestCase):
+    def test_compiled_all_reduce_is_one_graph(self):
+        group = _group("tp:compiled", accepts=True)
+        compiled = torch.compile(
+            lambda x: GroupCoordinator.all_reduce(group, x),
+            fullgraph=True,
+            backend="eager",
+        )
+
+        out = compiled(torch.empty(4, 8, device="meta"))
+
+        self.assertEqual(out.shape, (4, 8))
+
+    def test_op_leaves_its_input_untouched(self):
+        schema = torch.ops.sglang.diffusion_all_reduce.default._schema
+        self.assertFalse(
+            any(a.alias_info and a.alias_info.is_write for a in schema.arguments)
+        )
+
+    @unittest.skipUnless(torch.cuda.is_available(), "the op is registered for CUDA")
+    def test_op_reaches_the_group_by_name(self):
+        group = _group("tp:dispatch", accepts=True)
+        x = torch.ones(4, device="cuda")
+
+        out = torch.ops.sglang.diffusion_all_reduce(x, group.unique_name)
+
+        torch.testing.assert_close(out, x * 2)
+        torch.testing.assert_close(x, torch.ones(4, device="cuda"))
+
+    def test_out_of_place_reduce_uses_the_custom_all_reduce(self):
+        group = _group("tp:custom", accepts=True)
+        x = torch.ones(4)
+
+        torch.testing.assert_close(group._all_reduce_out_of_place(x), x * 2)
+
+    def test_out_of_place_fallback_reduces_a_copy(self):
+        group = _group("tp:fallback", accepts=False)
+        x = torch.ones(4)
+
+        with patch.object(
+            group_coordinator.torch.distributed,
+            "all_reduce",
+            side_effect=lambda tensor, group: tensor.mul_(3),
+        ):
+            out = group._all_reduce_out_of_place(x)
+
+        torch.testing.assert_close(out, torch.full((4,), 3.0))
+        torch.testing.assert_close(x, torch.ones(4))
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    unittest.main()
